problems.title: Linked List Cycle
problems.notes: Floyd's cycle detection, the pattern's namesake — fast/slow meet iff a cycle exists

problems.title: Middle of the Linked List
problems.notes: slow reaches the middle exactly when fast hits the end — the building block for LL reversal and reorder problems

problems.title: Palindrome Linked List
problems.notes: find the middle (fast/slow) + reverse the second half, O(1) space instead of an O(n) array copy

problems.title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
problems.notes: two-pointer length-equalize trick: walk both, hop each to the other list's head at the end, they meet in O(1) space

problems.title: Happy Number
problems.notes: cycle detection on a functional graph, not a linked list — proves the technique generalizes beyond next-pointers

problems.title: Linked List Cycle II
problems.notes: after fast/slow meet, reset one pointer to head and advance both by one — the distance proof is the real interview question

problems.title: Find the Duplicate Number
problems.notes: array-as-linked-list trick: treat nums[i] as next[i], then run Floyd's — the array is never mutated, unlike cyclic sort

problems.title: Reorder List
problems.notes: find middle + reverse second half + merge alternately — three techniques chained into one solution

problems.title: Circular Array Loop
problems.notes: direction-consistency check turns this into fast/slow with a twist: a valid cycle can't change sign mid-loop
